FIX IS HUMAN-REQUIRED (protected path). Minimal root-cause fix: add `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` to the `with:` block of each anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 step in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml (standard-tier, deep Fable-5, deep Opus-fallback). Adding it to all three is the robust choice; strictly only the two deep steps are reachable today (escalation always dispatches tier=deep), but standard could be bot-dispatched by a future change. Scope to the specific bot login, NOT '*': this is a PUBLIC repo and the action's docs warn '*' can let external Apps invoke the action with prompts they control. Confirmed against the action's own action.yml today: `allowed_bots` = 'Comma-separated list of allowed bot usernames, or ''*'' to allow all bots. Empty string (default) allows no bots.' The action strips the trailing `[bot]` before comparing, so `github-actions` and `github-actions[bot]` are equivalent (both match the github-actions[bot] actor).
